entities.title: Design documents
entities.summary: The remake's design, phase by phase of create-retro-game: the rules, the game design, the wireframes, the art bible, the UI design, the test plan and the provenance record, with the contact sheet.
entities.purpose: Says what the game does (RULES.md, the authority on every rule, number, draw and quirk) and how it looks, sounds and reads (GDD.md, WIREFRAMES.md, ART-BIBLE.md, UI-DESIGN.md), what was checked (TEST-PLAN.md) and where everything came from (PROVENANCE.md). The implementer read only these; the code cites their sections.
boundaries: No text or invented name from the original; the guard test reads this folder too.
contact-sheet.png is generated by scripts/contact-sheet.ts with npm run sheet.
The baseline and the reference material stay in a private repository.
